name: connect-profisee-to-profisee-bootstrap
description: What: Build of the Profisee to Profisee test track, run first by every connect-test-*-profisee-to-profisee-export: Set API Key Profisee To Profisee, Target Model Build, Profisee To Profisee Connect Setup, Target Baseline Backup. On the target it builds only this family (the Dba domains and PDataProfiseeToProfiseeImport); it never deletes another entity. Export only: the service offers no Import flow. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: workloads it runs: connect-api-key-set-profisee-to-profisee, connect-model-profisee-to-profisee-target-build, connect-profisee-to-profisee-connect-setup, connect-profisee-to-profisee-target-baseline-create. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.
globalParametersNotes: Each child owns its globals (a child global beats a parent global), so every child also runs on its own.

inline.description: What: Set the test API key on the Profisee to Profisee target instance. Why: Runs the child workload 'connect-api-key-set-profisee-to-profisee' so its tested steps are reused here, not repeated. Success: The child workload ends with every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Open the run output of 'connect-api-key-set-profisee-to-profisee'; its first failed step says what to check.
